title: Slot and Trochoidal Slot on a curved DXF centerline, and more than one slot chain in one operation

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:max
labels.description: New algorithms, formats or open design (issue-worker-max)

body:
This issue holds the part of #1868 that its pull request does not do. Part of #1452.

## What works after #1868

A `Slot` or a `Trochoidal Slot` reads one picked chain of a DXF profile:

- one closed line-arc slot outline (it seeds `a`, `b` and `width`);
- one open straight chain as the centerline (it seeds `a` and `b`).

## What is refused by name today

1. An open chain that is not straight (an arc, or a chain of lines and arcs). The message is "the picked centerline is not straight".
2. A closed chain used as a centerline (a circular groove). A closed chain is read as a slot outline only.
3. A selection with more than one chain (a layer of slots). The message is "a slot on a DXF profile cuts one chain".

## Why it is not in #1868

- `OpParams::Slot` and `OpParams::TrochoidalSlot` hold two points and one width. The generator, the machine area (`material_source.rs`), the fit law (`slot_fit.rs`, `slot_room.rs`) and the WCS rotation read these numbers.
- A curved channel needs a new parameter form. That is a project file change with a version bump.
- The plain Slot generator (`machining2d::slot`) cuts a straight channel only. A curved channel with a width larger than the tool needs offset rows along a chain. That is a new algorithm.
- `machining2d::trochoidal_slot` takes a point chain already. Its machine area and its fit law do not.

## Scope

- Let the two slot kinds follow a curved centerline at the typed width.
- Make the machine area the sweep of the centerline. The verification and the stock simulation must use it.
- Decide how a closed chain is read: as an outline or as a centerline. A wrong guess cuts in the wrong place, so the user must choose.
- Let one operation cut each chain of a selection, or keep one chain for each operation and say so in the user guide.

## Done means

- A `Slot` and a `Trochoidal Slot` on an open line-arc chain generate passes that stay inside the swept channel. A golden CL file pins each.
- A channel narrower than the tool, and a centerline with a corner tighter than the tool can follow, are refused by name.
- The straight slots of #1868 and the two-point `.camproj` slots give the same output as before.

## Evidence

- `crates/app/src/operation/slot_sketch.rs` (`resolve`) and `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_room_line.rs` (`from_centerline`) hold the refusals.
- `crates/app/tests/slot_dxf_sketch.rs`, test `picks_that_are_no_slot_are_refused_by_name`, pins them.
- `docs/decisions/1868-slot-dxf-sketches.md` records the decision.

Priority note: this is a follow-up that an agent found during work, so it has `P7` by the rule. It is the remaining scope of a `P4` issue. The maintainer can raise it.
